say.text: **Baby A**: significant RVOT obstruction. Most of the blood shunts toward the aorta, bypassing the pulmonary bed.
**Baby B**: if resistance across the RVOT is less than systemic vascular resistance, the child is minimally cyanotic or acyanotic. Moderate obstruction gives a **pink Tet**, with a loud murmur.

say.text: Think of blood taking the easier exit: compare the resistance across the RVOT with systemic vascular resistance.
When the RVOT is the harder exit, most blood goes toward the aorta instead.
